title: BlockFlow Preset
description: A self-contained recipe BlockFlow's preset installer can apply to a ComfyGen endpoint. One JSON file per preset.

id.description: Kebab-case identifier (e.g. 'wan22-t2v', 'sdxl-turbo'). Must be globally unique within the registry.

name.description: Display name shown in BlockFlow's preset picker.

description.description: One-paragraph explanation of what this preset is + when to pick it.

comfygen_min_version.description: Minimum ComfyGen worker version the preset requires (semver). Installer rejects on mismatch.

tags.description: Free-form tags for filtering ('video', 't2v', 'flux', 'turbo', 'wan-2.2', etc.). Lowercase, dots/hyphens allowed for version-like tags.

workflows.description: One or more ComfyUI workflows attached to this preset. Models are the install unit and shared across all workflows; workflows are alternate ways to drive the same model bundle (e.g. I2V vs V2V variants). The ComfyGen block dropdown shows one entry per workflow.

name.description: Display name shown in the ComfyGen block dropdown after the preset name (e.g. 'I2V', 'V2V', 'Image Edit').

json.description: Inline ComfyUI workflow in API format (node-id-keyed). Mutually exclusive with url+sha256.

url.description: HTTPS URL of the workflow JSON. Pinned to a release tag. Mutually exclusive with json.

sha256.description: SHA256 of the workflow JSON for integrity. Required with url.

settings.description: Optional author-declared knobs surfaced as a 'Workflow Settings' panel in the ComfyGen block. Use this for nodes that aren't picked up by auto-detection (KSampler / LoRA / Resolution / Reference Video / Frame Count / Prompt panels). Empty array or omitted field → no panel. Entries that overlap with auto-detected fields are silently ignored at render time — auto-detection wins.

node_id.description: Node ID in the workflow whose input this knob edits.

field.description: Name of the input field on the target node.

label.description: Display label shown next to the widget.

type.description: Widget type. int/float → numeric input; string → text input; bool → checkbox; combo → select with choices.

description.description: Optional short helper text shown below the widget.

choices.description: Allowed values for combo widgets. Required when type=combo, ignored otherwise.

smoke_inputs.description: Optional fixture inputs for ComfyGen's CI smoke gate. Each entry patches one input field on a specific node before the smoke-test submit. Workflows with no file inputs (pure prompt-driven, e.g. T2I) omit this field. BlockFlow's installer ignores this field; it's consumed by the smoke gate only.

node_id.description: Node ID in the workflow whose input should be patched (e.g. '311' for a LoadImage node, '417' for VHS_LoadVideo).

field.description: Input field name on the target node — typically 'image', 'video', 'audio', or 'mask'.

url.description: HTTPS URL of the fixture file. By convention lives under registry/<id>/fixtures/.

sha256.description: SHA256 of the fixture file for integrity.

filename.description: Local filename the smoke gate writes to before submission. Matches the node's expected basename convention.

hidden_nodes.description: Node IDs to suppress from the ComfyGen block's auto-detected panels (KSampler / LoRA / Resolution / Frame / RefVideo / LoadNode / Text). Hidden nodes still execute with whatever values the workflow JSON ships; they just don't get a UI knob. Unknown IDs are silently ignored. Use to declutter when a workflow has fixed values the end-user shouldn't override.

source.description: Where the model lives. Affects how the installer authenticates the download.

url.description: Direct download URL. For huggingface/civitai, the installer will inject the user's API token at install time.

dest.description: Path on the ComfyGen network volume, under the appropriate ComfyUI models subfolder.

sha256.description: REQUIRED. SHA256 hash of the file (hex, lowercase). ComfyGen's worker uses this for content-addressable dedup — if the file already exists at the destination with this hash, the download is skipped (cached: true). For HuggingFace LFS files, fetch via the API: GET /api/models/<repo>/tree/<branch>?recursive=1 returns lfs.oid per file.

size_gb.description: Approximate size in GB. Sum across all models must match disk_size_estimate_gb (±10%).

disk_size_estimate_gb.description: Total GB the preset needs on the ComfyGen volume (sum of all model files plus a ~20% buffer for temp + cache).

tested_against.description: What the preset author tested before proposing.

recommendations.description: Optional prose tips surfaced inline in the ComfyGen block. `global` applies to every workflow in the preset; `workflows` keys map workflow display names to their own tip lists. Both scopes optional.
